chunks: And Zarif ibn Nasih narrated in his book, like that.

key_terms.دِيَةِ الشّفَتَينِ: blood money for the two lips, a specific financial compensation in Islamic jurisprudence
key_terms.ظَرِيفُ بْنُ نَاصِحٍ: Zarif ibn Nasih, a Shia narrator
key_terms.كِتَابِهِ: his book, referring to the specific work of the narrator

ai.seo_question: Who narrated the ruling regarding the blood money for the lips in al-Ishtibars?
ai.summary: This brief narration serves as a corroborative link in the chain of transmission, citing Zarif ibn Nasih’s independent recording of the ruling on lip blood money (diyah). It highlights the scholarly practice of cross-referencing multiple authorities within the *Mustadrak* tradition to establish the reliability of specific jurisprudential details regarding physical injuries.
